predecessors.name: Duchy of Bavaria
predecessors.text: Bishop Ulrich 'was formally recognized as a prince of the empire at the Reichstag of Nuremberg in January 1217'; the seat at Passau

successors.name: Duchy of Bavaria
successors.text: 'the City of Passau and the temporalities on the left bank of the Inn and the right bank of the Ilz went to Bavaria' (Bavarians entered Passau on 22 February 1803)

successors.name: Electorate of Salzburg
successors.text: the territory on the left banks of the Danube and Ilz, to Ferdinand III of Habsburg-Lorraine

ledger.x: January 1217: a prince of the empire.

certainty.note: The page gives no area or boundary for the principality; the circle is a stand-in.
